Data extraction: HJSON flat object (JSON superset with comments)

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.tslp.android.*
import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() {
    val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper()
    val config = mapper.readValue("{\"data_extraction\":true,\"language\":\"hjson\"}", ProcessConfig::class.java)
    val result = TreeSitterLanguagePack.process("{\n  host: \"localhost\"\n  port: 8080\n}\n", config)
    println(result)
}
```
